newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom tops up employee shares.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom tops up employee shares.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, the German telecommunications giant, said on Monday it would increase the number of shares it planned to offer to employees when the company goes public next week.
The employee share offer, which is independent of the shares to be offered to the public, will have a volume of 30 million shares, up from 20 million previously.

The announcement follows a decision, made known earlier today, to raise its capital increase to three billion marks ($2 billion) from 2.5 billion marks previously, thereby topping up its initial public offer to 600 million shares from 500 million.
The company also increased its greenshoe option, or overallotment, to 90 million shares, from 75 million previously.
All shares have a face value of five marks and will be priced between 25 and 30 marks per share. ($ = 1.503 German Marks)
